name: EvalSpec
description: EvalSpec holds what a push says about the eval's current version.

fields.name: Tag
fields.description:
The tag the current version holds, such as "stable" or "v2"; empty when
 it holds none.

 A tag names one version at a time: pushing with a tag moves it to that
 version. "latest" is not a tag; a reference without a version, or with
 "latest", already names the current version.
